entries.5c045e221dbe18b7: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥942,505 million, an increase of ¥184,866 million (24.4%) from the previous year. By segment, revenue from external customers was ¥431,723 million for the residential business, ¥318,711 million for the urban development business, ¥109,653 million for the operational management business, ¥62,322 million for the brokerage and CRE business, ¥16,102 million for the asset management business and ¥3,718 million for the overseas business, and ¥275 million for other. Revenue in the residential business increased due to a higher average price of for-sale housing and an increase in sales of income-producing properties, and revenue in the urban development business increased due to an increase in sales of income-producing properties. Revenue in the overseas business decreased mainly due to a decline in the number of for-sale housing units recorded in Vietnam.
